reviewer: Codex exported-asset visual and Blender source review

views.front: Three shaped seats and three inclined back cushions read separately; seam compression is visible, the sculpted arms and splayed frame form a recognizable sofa. Matte wool no longer shows the first trial's rubbery highlight.
views.rear: Individually cut oak members, seventeen rear spindles and the pitched cushion backs remain coherent, with frame joints and support construction visible.
views.detail: Photographic textile variation and attached welts remain visible; the wool is matte and tintable. Timber grain follows each member, with separate scan cuts. Very fine yarn is naturally subtler at room distance.
views.underside: Recessed support slats meet the lower frame, cushion undersides rest on the support grid, and all four small foot glides meet the floor. No support slat ends protrude into the front silhouette.
views.clay: The improvement survives removal of materials: rounded boxing, individual cushion crowns, modest seam tucks, shaped arms and tapered splayed legs are actual exported mesh geometry.

limitations: Approval is for a Beta candidate and asset integrity, not the user's requested 8/10 visual rating.
This is an original 2000 x 850 x 780 mm design study informed by real construction, not a manufacturer-accurate replica.
Timber end caps do not yet have a dedicated ring-and-pore end-grain map.
The browser viewer and Cycles reference renders use different renderers; comparisons within each use shared cameras, lighting and tint.
This single sofa study does not replace catalog models or alter saved home data.
